what_this_feels_like.description: Energy is present but not crisp, with a slightly heavier bounce-back and a muted mental edge. Effort can feel more noticeable than usual, even when nothing is obviously wrong.

what_to_respect.boundary: Overall system sensitivity to cumulative load.

why.context: At this point in the cycle, the body often shifts into a quieter recalibration phase where tolerance for stress is narrower.

keep_in_mind.anchor: Weeks like this tend to be about letting things settle rather than pushing for sharpness.

optional_insight.title: Why bounce-back feels different this week
optional_insight.body: Recovery can feel less elastic during certain parts of the cycle, where steadiness supports better long-term rhythm than rapid rebounds.
